pros: ["High Reward Rate", "Earn 5% back as NeuCoins on Tata Neu and partner brands, including Air India, and 1.5% on other retail spends.", "Complimentary Lounge Access", "Cardholders get 2 domestic and 1 international complimentary airport lounge access per quarter without any spending requirements.", "UPI Spend Rewards", "The RuPay variant allows earning NeuCoins on UPI spends, a unique feature among credit cards.", "Fuel Surcharge Waiver", "Enjoy a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions between Rs. 400 and Rs. 5,000, with a maximum waiver of Rs. 500 per statement.", "Good Redemption Value", "NeuCoins earned can be redeemed at a value of 1 NeuCoin = Rs. 1 across various Tata brands, offering good redemption flexibility."]
cons: ["High Annual Fee", "The annual fee of Rs. 1,499 + GST is high for a co-branded credit card, though it can be waived by spending Rs. 3 lakh in a year.", "Limited Earning Categories", "NeuCoins are not earned on fuel spends, wallet loads, cash advances, and certain payments like rent and government transactions.", "Reward Caps", "Reward earnings are capped on grocery, insurance, and UPI spends, limiting the potential for maximum rewards.", "No SmartBuy Benefits", "The card is not eligible for HDFC Bank SmartBuy program, missing out on additional offers and discounts.", "Complex Reward Structure", "The complex system of earning and redeeming NeuCoins, with varying percentages and caps, can be confusing."]
